title: Open a created Show on its Production surface

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0051 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-23 directive to advance to the next frontier node after CHG-0050. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0051.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors and the 2026-08-23 user directive.

claims.statement: CHG-0050 recorded AC-005 as unimplemented: creating a Show added it to the list without navigating, so OverlayKit did not open the Show on its Production surface as SPEC-0001 AC-005 specifies. This change closes that gap.
claims.evidence: CHG-0050 deferred unknown and studio/src/views/ShowsView.vue createShow before this change.

claims.statement: The fix adds a router navigation to the created Show's Production route in the Studio create flow; the CHG-0049 browser harness proves the observable behavior end to end against the real server.

Governed discovery reordered the work: the AC-005 gap was a missing single-page navigation, not a deeper issue, so the slice is a small product fix plus a browser proof, and the harder Editor authoring criteria stay deferred.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-23 and the createShow implementation.

claims.statement: Navigating to /shows/:showId/production after create satisfies 'OverlayKit opens that Show on its Production surface with isolated resources'; the isolated-resource boundary is already enforced by the Show-scoped routes proven elsewhere.
claims.evidence: The browser proof that a created Show lands on its Production surface with its own workspace is the falsification mechanism.

claims.statement: Human review accepted CHG-0051: the Studio create flow now routes to the created Show's Production surface, so creating a Show with valid metadata opens it on Production in a real browser (AC-005). The change is a five-line single-page navigation in ShowsView; the Editor authoring and Library criteria stay deferred.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/ShowsView.vue, server/tests/e2e/studioAuthoring.test.ts (fails before the fix, passes after), the passing Studio unit suite and full server suite under npm run check, the CHG-0051 pull-request Constitution run (all eight jobs), and human acceptance on 2026-08-23.

claims.statement: The change adds only the Studio create-flow navigation; no server or protocol behavior changes, the Studio unit tests and full server suite pass, and the OBS proof continues to skip where OBS is absent.
claims.evidence: git diff of the CHG-0051 branch (studio/src/views/ShowsView.vue plus server/tests and governance) and the pull-request validate job.

claims.statement: AC-006, AC-007 and AC-008 Editor authoring and Send to Preview, and AC-009 Library, remain unproven at the browser tier because they run through the iframed legacy Editor and a placeholder Library; they are deferred to successors that reuse the harness.

successCriteria.statement: Creating a Show with valid metadata opens it on its Production surface in a real browser, with the created Show's own workspace (AC-005).
successCriteria.verification: Browser harness creates a Show and asserts the Production route, heading and the created Show name in the workspace.

successCriteria.statement: The change adds only the Studio create-flow navigation; the existing Studio unit tests and the full server suite pass and no other product behavior changes.
successCriteria.verification: Path-scoped review of studio/src/views/ShowsView.vue plus npm run check and the Studio unit suite.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0051 records the AC-005 closure and the deferred Editor and Library authoring criteria before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: The Studio create flow navigates to the created Show's Production surface and a browser test proves the observable behavior.
The browser test passes and the Studio unit tests and full server suite pass, with the OBS proof skipping on runners without OBS.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run check, the Studio unit suite and the focused authoring run.

definitionOfDone.statement: Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit (0 vulnerabilities), ESLint and git diff --check; the accept commit is verified by its own pull-request Constitution run before merge.
